flags.finding: Scene S011 depicts an unpermitted boat burn involving diesel fuel and fireworks on water at night, with a 10-year-old minor (Sam) and an animal (Barnacle) in close proximity in a skiff. Additionally, a flare gun is used (S010, S011) and a major stunt involves Mara diving into the dark water near the burning boat. The explicit mention of the boat burn being 'unpermitted' in the triage makes this scene uninsurable and illegal as written. This combination of hazards (large-scale fire, explosives, minor, animal, night water stunt) creates an extremely high-risk environment that requires extensive safety protocols, specialized personnel, and multiple permits. Without proper permits and safety measures, this scene cannot be filmed.
